name: Belmond Las Casitas
positioning: Casitas with private plunge pools in a remote, quiet spot in the Colca Valley (Condé Nast Traveler lists it as Las Casitas del Colca)
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet, remote retreat in the Colca Valley
Guests who want a private plunge pool at their casita

facts.text: The hotel is in a remote, quiet location in the Colca Valley.
The Colca Valley has been home to pre-Inca inhabitants since 600 AD, including the Collagua and Cabana tribes.
Nineteen casitas each have a private terrace and plunge pool.
The Presidential Casita has a private garden and plunge pool.
The restaurant is Curiña, serving contemporary Peruvian cuisine.
The hotel has a cocktail bar called Puccq'io.
The hotel has an outdoor heated swimming pool.
Activities include hiking trails, horseback tours and birdwatching.
The hotel has a cultivated vegetable garden.

highlights.text: The casitas have wood-burning fireplaces, heated laja-stone floors and plunge pools on the private terraces.
Llamas and alpacas live on the property.
The property has a restored on-site chapel.
Guests can set off before dawn to see Andean condors rising on thermal winds above the Colca Canyon.

considerations.text: The hotel is in a remote, quiet location in the Colca Valley, so it is a retreat rather than a town base.
Nights can be chilly at 9,800 feet above sea level.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires extensive travel from major cities.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Las Casitas del Colca
